american_ephemeris_2000_2050_empirical_v.description: Empirical short-range lunar calibration for matching JPL/American Ephemeris-style geocentric tropical Moon longitude over 2000-2050. Uses initial geocentric tangential velocity correction plus empirical geocentric tangential acceleration.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_empirical_v.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar along-track acceleration. Do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.

american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_e.description: Full-book 2000-01-01 to 2050-12-31 peak-optimized empirical lunar calibration.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_e.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar along-track acceleration. Do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.

american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_4.description: Full-book 2000-01-01 to 2050-12-31 four-parameter empirical lunar calibration. Best observed longitude peak from focused dual-annealing/Powell search.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_4.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar radial/tangential/out-of-plane initial velocity correction + empirical lunar along-track acceleration. Do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.

american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_6.description: Exploratory six-parameter v4 seed based on trial 58 from the initial v4 dual-annealing journal.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_6.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar radial/tangential/out-of-plane initial velocity correction + empirical lunar radial/tangential/out-of-plane acceleration. Seed profile for trend-aware v4 annealing; do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.

american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_6.description: Six-parameter v4 candidate based on trial 846 from the focused v4 dual-annealing/Powell journal. Best observed objective and longitude peak in the 1473-trial summary.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_6.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar radial/tangential/out-of-plane initial velocity correction + empirical lunar radial/tangential/out-of-plane acceleration. Candidate v4 profile from trial 846; do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.
